posts.text: Spent the day canvassing in New Jersey's 7th Congressional District with Swing Left and volunteers from their Ground Truth program. We knocked on doors, listened, and took the time to hear what people are actually worried about. You can do the same thing from anywhere in the country! Head to the link in bio. #groundtruthpartner
posts.summary: Encourages voter engagement and door-to-door canvassing for Democratic candidates
